description: Open an attachment. Text and PDF come back as text, images as images, other files as a binary resource. Give save_to to write it to a local file instead.

account.description: Which mailbox to use. Defaults to the first. Pass the Mailbox shown in a list result when acting on that email.

email_id.description: The email the attachment belongs to.

save_to.description: Local path to save the file to.

name: get_attachment
